headline: Man with MS finds purpose knitting tuques from custom cot
meta_description: A man living with MS has found a meaningful way to stay active and spread warmth by knitting tuques from a specially designed cot.
summary_short: Despite losing his legs to multiple sclerosis, one man has discovered purpose and connection through knitting tuques on a custom-made cot.
body:
A man who lost his legs to multiple sclerosis has found an inspiring way to stay engaged and uplift his community: knitting tuques from a custom-made cot.

Working from his specially designed cot, he transforms yarn into handmade winter hats—each one a tangible gift that keeps someone warm. The project reflects both resourcefulness and determination, turning physical limitation into creative output that benefits others.

His work has captured hearts not just for the tuques themselves, but for what they represent: a refusal to be defined by illness, and a commitment to making a positive difference despite significant challenges. Each hat carries the warmth of his hands and spirit.
quick_facts: Man lost legs to multiple sclerosis
Knits tuques from a custom-made cot
Handmade winter hats warm community members
